intro: Meet Arcadia—the perfect solution for modern homes. Its half-hydraulic storage makes accessing your essentials a breeze, while its stylish headboard design adds elegance to your space​.

features.title: Neutral design with three-piece foil clad panels
features.text: Intricate deadboard design with three-piece foil clad create a striking focal point that adds instant character to your space.

features.title: Storage that works for you
features.text: Storage made easy. The half hydraulic lift-up mechanism gives you effortless access to under-bed storage, while the half box compartment keeps essentials organised.

features.title: Sturdy metal understructure for enhanced durability
features.text: You deserve furniture that lasts—the sturdy 1.2 mm metal frame provides long-term strength you can count on.

features.title: A finish that stays beautiful
features.text: Built to last—scratch-resistant prelaminated particle board keeps your furniture looking pristine every day.

features.title: Knockdown design for easy installation
features.text: Quick assembly means less time setting up and more time relaxing—because your comfort matters.

name: Arcadia V2 Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Half Hydraulic Storage
